messages:
incident-bot: PAGE FIRED - autoscaler.queue-backlog HIGH (sev: P1)
incident-bot: Trigger: pending_requests > 40k for 8m AND scale_attempts >= 5; service=hosted-generation region=us-west1
pagerduty: New alert INC-2026-5521 -> Escalation policy: eng-oncall
jamie (oncall): ack'd. I'm on it. pulling dashboards and runbook. :coffee:
praveen (SRE): quick glance: scale-controller issued repeated scale requests but cloud returns provisioning errors. scale_attempts=7, last_error="no accelerators available"
lara (infra): confirmed from provider console. GPU quota exhausted in us-west1. manual create attempt returned "quota limit reached". also seeing provisioning API 429s from provider while requests backlogged.
sasha (prod-ops): customer impact: intermittent 429s and stalled streams for hosted endpoints in us-west. Not full outage but high latency and partial failures for latency-sensitive customers. prepping copy for status page.
jamie (oncall): immediate mitigations we can do now: 1) shift new traffic to us-central (spare capacity) 2) apply CPU-only fallback for non-critical keys 3) check for any dedicated/reserved pools we can borrow. who can run routing?
praveen (SRE): I'll flip the emergency routing. runbook command: 
``
redwoodctl route override --service hosted-generation --from-region us-west1 --to-region us-central1 --mode emergency
```
praveen (SRE): executing...
praveen (SRE): applied at 4612345725. ingress policy updated; gradual traffic shift started.
jamie (oncall): watching queues...
praveen (SRE): us-west pending queue: 52,300 -> 8,900 within ~90s after routing change. p95 latency 15s -> 4.2s. error rate dropping. routing helped.
lara (infra): opening emergency support ticket CASE-2026-RW-78 for quota increase. requesting expedited quota. also found ded-pool-03 with 16 GPUs in enterprise account that might be borrowed; needs billing/ops approval to attach.
sasha (prod-ops): drafting status: "We are experiencing elevated latency and intermittent rate limiting in us-west. Traffic is being rerouted to reduce impact; engineers are provisioning additional capacity." Will publish in 8m unless situation resolves.
praveen (SRE): applied model-fallback for low-tier keys to cpu-lite variant: 
``
redwoodctl config set model.fallback --selector tier=trial --variant cpu-lite
```
praveen (SRE): applied; estimated 18% of queue relieved.
jamie (oncall): logs from scale-controller: 
``
scale-controller: attempt=7 target_replicas=120 result=ProvisionFailed err="insufficient accelerators"
provisioner: last_response=QuotaExceeded code=403
```
praveen (SRE): autoscaler is healthy but blocked by upstream resource shortage; not a control-plane bug.
lara (infra): provider on-call engaged; they acknowledged emergency request. ETA for quota bump ~40-90 minutes. Meanwhile trying to arrange hot-attach of ded-pool-03.
sasha (prod-ops): status published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-15-autoscaler-capacity
jamie (oncall): current snapshot at 4612345890: us-west pending ~6.6k, p95=3.1s, p99=7.8s, 429 rate ~0.8%. Holding page until quota or reserved attach confirmed or queue drains to <1k.
praveen (SRE): handoff plan: lara to continue with provider support & reserved pool attach, sasha owns customer comms, jamie will monitor and update PD. I'll be reachable for escalation.
lara (infra): update: billing gave provisional approval to borrow ded-pool-03; starting attach sequence (may cause brief reconnects).
praveen (SRE): noted. attaching spare pool now...
praveen (SRE): ded-pool-03 attached at 4612345935. provisioning of pods on attached nodes in progress.
jamie (oncall): post-attach metrics: us-west pending dropping to ~900 within 60s, p95=1.6s, error rate down to 0.2%. Looks stable.
lara (infra): provider increased quota as well; confirmed in console. closing support case when monitoring confirms stability.
sasha (prod-ops): updating incident timeline and will queue postmortem steps: root cause = regional accelerator quota exhaustion leading to failed provisioning despite autoscaler requests; mitigations=regional failover, model fallback, reserved pool attach, emergency quota increase.
pagerduty: Incident INC-2026-5521 acknowledged by jamie (oncall)
jamie (oncall): thanks all. I'm closing the pager for now but keeping a monitoring watch for 2 hours. will file postmortem and include exact commands and logs. :white_check_mark:
